steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.endTour?.(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setLocation?.({ lat: 1.3521, lon: 103.8198, label: 'SG' }); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setQualityTier?.('high'); })()

steps.name: set-door-bifold-vinyl
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const door=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='door'); if (door) st.updateOpening(door.id,{style:'bifold',material:'vinyl'}); return door ? door.id : null; })()

steps.name: camera-at-door
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const door=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='door'); const wall=fp.walls.find(w=>w.id===door.wallId); const len=Math.hypot(wall.end[0]-wall.start[0],wall.end[1]-wall.start[1]); const ux=(wall.end[0]-wall.start[0])/len, uz=(wall.end[1]-wall.start[1])/len; const cx=wall.start[0]+ux*(door.offset+door.width/2), cz=wall.start[1]+uz*(door.offset+door.width/2); const c=window.__three.controls; const cam=window.__three.camera; cam.position.set(cx-uz*2.4+ux*0.8, 1.6, cz+ux*2.4+uz*0.8); c.target.set(cx, 1.0, cz); c.update(); return [cx,cz]; })()

steps.name: door-open
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const door=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='door'); st.toggleDoor(door.id); return door.id; })()
